warnings: ฐานรากแบบที่ 2 = spread-footing alternative (boxed [F1]/[F2] on S-01). These F1/F2 are NOT the pile cap F1 of S-05 — same printed mark, different system.
Plan prints '7-DB 12' / '10-DB 16' per direction; sections print '7x2-DB12mm#' / '10x2-DB16mm#' -> count is the two-way total (14 / 20). Square footings, so depth_mm omitted.

Notes (รายการประกอบแบบฐานรากแผ่): use only where a load test gives safe bearing >= 8 t/m2 (SF 2.5); 1 boring test; depth D per the soil report — recorded in the transcript only, not as element fields.
